CHROMEMIC 1.2 — QUICK START
===========================

WHAT IT DOES
Mixes one selected application's audio with your optional selected microphone
and sends only that mix into a virtual microphone cable. Game sound and
unrelated applications stay excluded.

SETUP
1. Install a trusted cable such as VB-CABLE: https://vb-audio.com/Cable/index.htm
2. Open Chrome and play the YouTube/video/audio you want to send.
3. Run ChromeMic.exe and wait for the GitHub update check to say 1.2.0 is current.
4. APPLICATION AUDIO: choose Chrome. Refresh apps if it is missing.
5. OPTIONAL VOICE: enable Include microphone, choose your mic, then choose
   Natural, Clear Mic, Broadcast, Radio, Robot, or Deep Tone.
6. GAME CABLE: choose its playback side (normally CABLE Input for VB-CABLE).
7. Press Start routing and check all relevant meters.
8. In the game, choose the matching recording side as its microphone
   (normally CABLE Output for VB-CABLE).

LOOPBACK TEST
Enable "Loopback test — hear microphone/effect in headphones" and select
physical headphones. It monitors the processed microphone only, not Chrome.
It is off at every launch. Never use the game cable as the monitor.

IMPORTANT
- Chrome scope is its selected process tree, not one tab.
- If Chrome or the enabled mic exits/disconnects, routing stops safely.
- Mute silences only the game cable; headphone loopback may continue.
- Routing is blocked until GitHub confirms this exact build is current; it
  checks again before every route start.
- Audio is never recorded or uploaded. The update check sends no audio or IDs.
- This unsigned app still requires a separately installed signed virtual cable.
